patch_description:
This implementation uses the strong antipodal representation of a 14-point 3D code as seven unoriented unit lines, returning each optimized line together with its antipode. In this representation the diameter is exactly positive and fixed at 2, while maximizing the minimum point distance is equivalent to minimizing the largest absolute inner product between distinct lines.

The search uses deterministic multi-start optimization of increasingly sharp power objectives, followed by accept-only active-contact polishing directly on the exact maximum correlation. This concentrates refinement on the pairs that currently determine the minimum distance, while preserving centering, spherical normalization, and antipodal diameter constraints exactly. The returned array has shape `(14, 3)` and is finite and deterministic.
